claim.value: If responsibility ambiguity is absent, it must not be claimed to have been removed.
claim.scope: A conditional limit on characterizing the intervention; absence is not asserted.

provenance.rationale: P028 explicitly supplies this conditional prohibition.

signal_basis.value: Verify whether responsibility was unclear before the intervention. The operation makes responsibility explicit conditional on ambiguity being present; its proposed signal is a subsequent reduction in missing attachments, repeated across comparable periods if volume permits.
signal_basis.scope: Characterizing the prospective intervention and its attachment signal; the signal does not itself establish that ambiguity was initially present.

provenance.rationale: These spans supply the initial verification, presence-conditioned operation, and qualified reduction signal.
The claim is supported as a conditional limit without an unresolved empirical relation.

rationale: Removing ambiguity presupposes that ambiguity was present. Even an observed improvement in attachment frequency cannot license describing an absent factor as having been removed. The claim therefore follows within its explicitly conditional scope.
uncertainty: Whether ambiguity was actually absent is not established or asserted; that does not undermine the conditional limit.
